title: Modern Treasury footer
description: A deep forest-green footer: a newsletter row (bold line, muted line, a white email field and a pale mint button), a hairline, six columns of small muted links under white headings (two columns on phones), and a legal row with the copyright, one link and grey social icons.
notes: always dark: it carries the dark class, so it uses the theme's dark colours in both modes
social icons come in as nodes (any icon set)
name: moderntreasury-footer

props.name: newsletter
props.type: { title: string; text: string; placeholder: string; button: string; action?: string; }
props.description: the newsletter row: a bold line, a muted line, the field's placeholder and the button

props.name: columns
props.description: the link columns; six fill the row on desktop

props.name: socials
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }[]
props.description: social links on the right; label is for screen readers
